correctness.rationale: The value/first-jet matrix on the seven P2(F2) points has full rank 21, so I5 is 14-dimensional and 3^7=2187 forms pass all rational first-jet tests. The independently reconstructed GF(2) mask, GL3 action and three-affine-chart Groebner unit-ideal tests found 1512 geometrically smooth forms, 50400 unordered XOR-valid pairs, and 16800 pencils. Exact projective-orbit enumeration gave (orbit size,base reducedness) multiplicities (168,true):93,(168,false):3,(56,true):9,(56,false):3. Bezout and transverse rational differentials give length25 with seven reduced rational points and residual length18; the 2-dimensional first-jet target at any rational point proves the global dimension upper bound. Tests use geometric unit ideals, not bounded extension-field sampling.
residual_risks: The independent exact enumeration recomputed the finite quantities; it does not classify scalar-extended pencil members or abstract genus-six curve isomorphisms.
